info.title: n8n Integration Adapter API
info.description: Machine-readable contract for externally callable n8n webhooks in the local ServiceDesk integration adapter.

x-localization.notes: Only human-facing OpenAPI metadata is localized. Paths, operationIds, schema names, payload fields, enum/const values, error codes and auth headers stay stable across locales.

callback_url_policy.orchestrator_public_url_match: In non-local environments ORCHESTRATOR_PUBLIC_URL is required for HTTP callback delivery. callback_url must have the same origin and the same or nested path.

http.notes: Local/dev may use http://127.0.0.1. Shared, staging and production deployments should publish n8n webhooks and ServiceDesk callback URLs through HTTPS selected by the administrator.

kafka.notes: Kafka is secured through broker TLS/SASL/mTLS credentials and ACLs, not HTTPS. Local/dev may use PLAINTEXT.

post.summary: Send a provider channel repair email and monitor Zabbix/email completion
post.description: Async-only composite runbook. It resolves provider email context from CMDBuild by host, sends the provider_channel_outage_test templated email, then polls Zabbix first and provider mailbox index second until Zabbix is ok/resolved, a provider reply is found, delivery fails, or timeout expires. The HTTP response is accepted; terminal business result is delivered as canonical ServiceDesk ExternalEvent.result.

post.summary: Verify an employee and claimed manager pair through HR export
post.description: Validates an employee full name and a claimed manager full name against the HR export. Returns OK only when exactly one employee-manager pair is confirmed through the selected administrative, managerial, or both relation types and both employee and manager tabular numbers are available. Business-negative outcomes return HTTP 200 with status ERROR and all found/not found people details.

post.description: Read-only string check for three full names. The workflow validates applicant, employee and manager full names, normalizes whitespace and case, and returns OK only when the applicant matches either the employee or the manager. It does not call HR or AD.

post.summary: Lookup an AD user login and email by full name and employee id
post.description: Read-only MS AD lookup. Validates an employee full name and tabular number, searches AD through the configured n8n LDAP credential, and returns OK only when exactly one AD user is found and the selected login and email attributes are not empty. Attribute names are caller-configurable with safe defaults.

post.description: Composite mutating runbook. Validates that the applicant is the employee or manager, verifies the claimed manager through HR data, looks up employee and manager in AD, resets the employee password, sends the generated password to the manager with the password reset notification template, and returns all completed step results without the generated password.
